verdict.rationale: An AI-training opt-out is a fair privacy-posture question for an accounting SaaS that offers automated suggestions, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions AI training, data-use policies, or any opt-out control. The automatic booking-category suggestion shows the product uses automation but says nothing about training-data use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
